chunks: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ziyad ibn Marwan, from Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), who said:

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى: Abu al-Hasan Musa, referring to Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS)
key_terms.دِرْهَمٍ: Dirham, a silver coin used as currency in Islamic jurisprudence

ai.seo_question: What is the specific amount of money to be given as charity according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) specifies one thousand dirhams as the minimum threshold for Zakat distribution, reflecting the economic standards of the 2nd century AH. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on ensuring recipients achieve a degree of financial sufficiency, distinguishing it from mere symbolic giving.
